findings: Timer/terminal stores, modes 7/17, Hermite basis and generic blending agree structurally for finite, nonaliasing states; production easing dependency propagates confirmed mode-12 error.

Slow timer conversion uses rounded state->elapsed in C++; assembly fst stores float without popping and __ftol2 converts the still-unrounded x87 sum. Counterexample is conditional on x87 precision above binary32 and nearest rounding.

findings: For valid nonnegative ring index and nonaliasing position, decimal order, any-negative single glyph 10, zero glyph, active/count/color/position stores, wrap at 720 and lazy timer final state agree.

C++ adds negative-index normalization and returns a record pointer; retail leaves negative index unchecked and EAX contains position[1] bits. These are adapter differences, not demonstrated reachable defects.

rows.precision: Integer/digit controls exact; ABI and pointer-width compatibility remain outside valid-state semantic agreement.

Generated th10_0100a.ver, success/failure return and publication order agree given faithful callbacks and size output. Raw Ghidra omits hidden filename register, so it cannot resolve the probe literal alone.
